body:
Repeated rubric identities keep the wording printed at the selected occurrence, with project/language fallback where no local wording is supplied. Single-column run-in labels and HTML copied text preserve a separating space before adjacent prayer words.

The copied parallel-PDF case is addressed separately by follow-up #315. This PR was merged before that later correction.

Validation at the merged revision: stylesheet and electronic-export regression suites passed. Digitization work remains in #296, contributing to #214.
